name: OACSP-Forensics
description: OACSP-Forensics: a cross-modal selective prediction benchmark for digital forensic triage. Applies ordinal-aware class-conditional selective prediction to phishing URLs (PhishTank), malware binaries (EMBER), and memory forensics (CIC-MalMem-2022) with Daubert-aligned evaluation and coverage-risk curves for court-admissible AI triage.
